title: Scaling Influence Functions in LLMs through Eigenbasis-Corrected One-Bit Gradient Projection
abstract: arXiv:2609.37842v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Influence functions estimate how individual training examples affect the behavior of large language models (LLMs). Analyzing how training data influence different behaviors of an LLM involves repeated influence computation. Reusing stored training gradients reduces the computational cost, but storing full gradients is prohibitively expensive at LLM scale. We study how to compress these gradients while preserving influence estimates for future queries that are unknown at storage time. Through a worst-case analysis, we characterize the optimal fixed-dimensional linear representation and propose eigenbasis-corrected one-bit gradient projection (EOGP) to approximate it at scale. Specifically, EOGP uses EK-FAC to reduce gradient dimensionality, then applies PCA within the retained subspace to learn compression directions from the training gradients. translated_title: 通过特征基校正的单比特梯度投影在大语言模型中扩展影响函数
translated_abstract: 影响函数用于估计单个训练样本如何影响大语言模型（LLM）的行为。分析训练数据如何影响LLM的各种行为需要反复进行影响计算。重用已存储的训练梯度可以降低计算成本，但在LLM规模下存储完整梯度的代价极其高昂。我们研究了如何在压缩这些梯度的同时，为存储时尚未确定的未来查询保留影响估计。通过最坏情况分析，我们刻画了最优的固定维度线性表示，并提出特征基校正的单比特梯度投影（EOGP）方法在大规模场景下对其进行近似。具体而言，EOGP首先使用EK-FAC降低梯度维度，然后在保留的子空间内应用PCA从训练梯度中学习压缩方向，随后对所得坐标进行单比特量化，从而允许存储更多的坐标信息。
tldr: 该论文提出EOGP方法，通过EK-FAC降维、PCA学习压缩方向和单比特量化三步压缩训练梯度，在极低存储成本下保留影响估计精度，实现了大语言模型规模上影响函数的高效扩展。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes EOGP, which compresses training gradients through EK-FAC dimensionality reduction, PCA-learned compression directions, and one-bit quantization, preserving influence estimates at minimal storage cost to scale influence functions for LLMs.
